data_when_fixed.seattle_open_data: Checkouts by Title, data.seattle.gov (resource tmmm-ytt6). The library last refreshed it on 2026-09-06 (the API field rowsUpdatedAt). On 2026-10-17 the API listed the months 2026-01 to 2026-08, with 232,103 to 251,169 rows a month. Only these row counts and the refresh date were read. No title, theme or checkout value of a later month is in the project files, and none has been downloaded.
data_when_fixed.demand_panel: data/db/study3/demand_panel.parquet, build 20261013-210004-a772613ac300, made with the Study 3 record SHA-256 eeeb6c80425a1d1c2a35e409e57e49d633155ad879f0147be9287bed48ded0b5; months to 2026-08 in print, ebook and audiobook.
data_when_fixed.interest_series: The curated English Wikipedia weekly series, the shift table, the shift effects and the book and author article series of Study 2R, as built on 2026-10-13. They hold weeks up to the week of 2026-09-28 (the last full week is 2026-09-21), but an input at origin 2026-08 uses only weeks whose Sunday is on or before 2026-08-31, as at every earlier origin (the record's rule, tested under checks).

origin_and_horizons: Origin 2026-08, the last month of the demand panel, complete in all three formats. Horizons 1, 2 and 3, so target months 2026-09, 2026-10 and 2026-11. Horizon 3 is included because Chronos-2, Chronos-Bolt and the change models give it at no extra cost and addendum b ran every pipeline of the list at horizons 1 to 3 for Seattle. Origins after 2026-08 are opened by a later addendum.
units: Seattle series (group seattle: print, ebook and audiobook; narrow and middle themes) that have a row at the origin in the Study 4b feature table as the benchmark code builds it: eligible by the Study 3 size rule over the 24 months before the origin month, with a log share at the origin. Whether a series can be scored is decided later, by its target month (observed, passing the month checks), not now. LibriVox is not part of the final test (addendum b: Seattle months).

pipelines.list: naive, chronos, chronos2_cur, chronos2_bk, chronos2_curdw, catchg_D, catchg_DW, catchg_DWS
pipelines.how_the_list_follows_from_addendum_b: Addendum b: naive and every pipeline that is in the stage-1 confidence set, or in the level or the rise confidence set of comparison A2 (at most the 12 with the lowest AvgRelMAE). The stage-1 set of the main comparison A (print and ebook, horizon 1, 21 pipelines) is chronos, catchg_DW, catchg_D and catchg_DWS. The A2 level set is chronos2_cur, chronos2_bk and chronos2_curdw. The A2 rise set is chronos2_bk, chronos2_cur and chronos2_curdw. Together seven pipelines and naive, below the cap of 12. The sets are those printed in data/reports/benchmark_stage1.md and data/reports/benchmark_stage2.md.
pipelines.added_reference: chronos2 (Chronos-2 without interest inputs). It is not in any confidence set and is not a candidate for best. It is run so that the effect of the interest inputs on one model can be stated on the new months, as it was in the main comparison (chronos2_cur against chronos2).

definitions.naive: y(t+h) = y(t), the log share at the origin.
definitions.chronos: amazon/chronos-bolt-small (cached snapshot 772f3d25d38aec6d914c8949dab4462e2d46f5d8), zero-shot, univariate, median forecast. Context = the series' log share up to and including the origin month, missing months left missing, at most the last 512 months. Horizons 1 and 2: the context is built from the history of the Study 4 feature table (the stage-1 construction); horizon 3: from the union of the Study 4 and Study 4b histories (as the horizon-3 run of addendum b, 2e).
definitions.chronos2_cur, chronos2_curdw, chronos2_b: Addendum b 2a: amazon/chronos-2, commit 29ec3766d36d6f73f0696f85560a422f50e8498c, CPU, float32, no cross-learning between series, median forecast for t+1, t+2 and t+3 from one call with prediction length 3, past covariates only. Covariates: chronos2_cur the monthly log share of the curated series (cur_wlog); chronos2_curdw that and the duration-weighted interest (cur_dwi); chronos2_bk the monthly log shares of the book and author article series (bkb_wlog, bka_wlog); chronos2 none. A covariate missing over the whole context of a task is dropped for that task. Contexts as for chronos at horizon 3.
definitions.catchg_D, catchg_DW, catchg_DWS: CatBoost trained on the change y(t+h) - y(t), feature sets D, D+W and D+W+S of Study 4b; forecast = y(t) + predicted change. 600 iterations, depth 6, learning rate 0.05, RMSE, seed 20261013; categorical format, level, broad category and target month; pooled over the three Seattle formats; expanding window retrained at the origin; training rows are origins s with s + h <= t and an observed target; at least 30 training rows.

inputs_and_training: Every input is a stored file named under data_when_fixed; nothing is downloaded or refreshed for this addendum. Training uses only rows whose target month is observed and not after 2026-08. Features at the origin use demand months up to 2026-08 and interest weeks whose Sunday is on or before 2026-08-31. Model settings, seeds and software are those of addendum b; no setting is tuned or changed.
software: python 3.12.11, pandas 3.0.6, numpy 2.5.4, scikit-learn 1.9.1, lightgbm 4.6.0, catboost 1.2.10, arch 8.0.0, torch 2.14.1, chronos-forecasting 2.0.1, transformers 4.57.6 (the versions installed on 2026-10-17, equal to addendum b).
protection: The forecasting code (code/main_study/benchmark/25_final_test_forecast.py, mode final) stops unless the prereg record has the SHA-256 printed in prereg/README.md, the origin has no observed target, and the demand panel holds no month after the origin.
Training rows come from the same functions as in the benchmark (study4/_models.training_rows), which keep only origins s with s + h <= t.
checks_before_the_forecasts_are_made: The feature table rebuilt by the benchmark code from the stored panel and interest files equals the stored Study 4b table on every row with an observed target (all numeric columns, to 1e-9).

The same forecasting code, run at known origins (2026-07, 2025-02, 2023-03 and 2019-06), reproduces the stored benchmark forecast of every pipeline of the list within 1e-4 in log share (report data/reports/benchmark_final_test_regression.md; rows are compared one by one, and an empty comparison counts as a failure).

Altering every weekly value, shift label and shift start after the last included week of the origin month (2026-08-24) leaves the interest features, the lasting-rise flag and the Chronos-2 covariates unchanged (mode timesafety).
If a check fails the forecasts are not made until the cause is found; the finding goes to prereg/DEVIATIONS.md.
freeze_and_publication: The forecasts are written to prereg/final_test/forecasts_origin_2026-08.csv with a meta file (prereg/final_test/forecasts_origin_2026-08_meta.json) holding the SHA-256 of the CSV, the SHA-256 of every input file, the software versions and the time. The SHA-256 of the CSV is added to prereg/README.md, and prereg/ is published to the public repository DolphinsAreWeird/cmkl-thesis-research with jobs/sync_github.sh the same day, so that the commit time is a date outside this computer. Nothing about a month after 2026-08 is read before that.
not_fixed_here: How the demand of a month after 2026-08 is built (works that first appear after August 2026, the month checks), which series and rows are scored, the metrics and their intervals for a small number of months (the record's 12-month rule cannot hold), the hypotheses and what counts as support, the date of scoring, and whether later origins are added. All of that is fixed in addendum d before any month after 2026-08 is downloaded. The forecasts of this addendum do not depend on it.
disclosures: Seen before fixing: every stage-1 and stage-2 result of the benchmark (52 pipelines, 88 test months to 2026-08), which chose the list, and the thesis draft of 16 Oct 2026.

deviations: Changes after this addendum go to prereg/DEVIATIONS.md under "Final unseen test".
